name: tenants_update_comparisons
description: Set how people in the active tenant compare their capabilities with others on their role at a level: enabled turns the comparison on or off; min_group_size is the fewest people a level needs before its scores show (at least 4, default 5), on the comparison and in the capability attainment report; snapshot_every_months is how often the group scores are taken, on the 1st of the month (1, 3 or 6, default 1). Only the settings given change. Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin.
